entities.summary: Cristian Gabriel Poglajen is an Argentine volleyball player. He was part of the Argentine national volleyball team. He competed with the national team at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London and the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro. He played with Sarmiento Voley in 2012.
